data.description: JSON task/people data, including owner, assignedBy, assignmentNote and creation confirmation. Use confirmation.text to report verified Task View/section placement and reminder timing; never guess a destination.

prepared.description: Prepared context only; no agent run or send has happened.

tasks.description: Formatted list of tasks for agent consumption

taskIds.description: Array of task IDs that can be used in cancel-task

agentScheduledTaskIds.description: Array of task IDs that have agent execution enabled

scheduledFor.description: Confirmed scheduler registration time; does not guarantee execution

outcome.description: Persisted task and scheduling outcomes. Never recreate a confirmed task to retry a later effect.

conflict.description: True if a task already exists in the same time window

taskId.description: ID of the conflicting existing task

dueDate.description: Due date of the existing task

existingTask.description: Details of the existing task to merge into via update-task

proposed.description: True if this is a proposed task awaiting approval

taskEffectOutcome.description: Persisted task and scheduling outcomes. Never recreate a confirmed task to retry a later effect.

outcome.description: Actual persistence outcome. blocked/unchanged do not mean a task was marked done.

taskStatus.description: Persisted task status after the update attempt.

changed.description: Whether a row actually moved. `success: true` with `changed: false` means nothing was written — the values already matched, or the task is protected from this run.

dueDate.description: Persisted deadline when a date was requested.

scheduledFor.description: New scheduled time if agent execution is enabled

cancelledTasks.description: List of task IDs that were successfully cancelled

proposed.description: True if this is a proposed cancellation awaiting approval

proposedCancellations.description: List of tasks proposed for cancellation (chat mode only)
